messages:
mira: Alert from synthetic monitors: eu-west1 embed p999 jumped ~12x after last canary. Users seeing timeouts. Need an emergency pin.
ash: any infra signals?
mira: no node crashes, no mem spikes. timing points to model decode regress.
devbot: auto: canary summary for ql-lite-4 -> p999 increase 2s -> 24s, errors +0.4%. Recommended action: revert alias to previous model or pause canary.
ash: safest quick fix is alias pin to ql-stable-3. ops, will that require rolling restarts?
ops-bot: ops-bot: alias update only. KV cache invalidation may affect in-flight requests, expect <1% errors for <40s. No restarts.
mira: approvals required (eng:2 + ops). I'm owner and +1. Nash can you approve?
nash: +1 from ENG. ops-bot: ops signoff granted.
mira: executing via devbot: `/devbot pin-model --alias eu-embed-default --model ql-stable-3 --region eu-west1 --reason "hotfix: ql-lite-4 tail latency regression"`
devbot: queued by mira. approvals satisfied. executing...
devbot: success: alias eu-embed-default -> ql-stable-3 (eu-west1). change_id: ch_6578901234_pin. propagation ~16s.
sre-oncall: monitoring: p99 back to baseline, p999 dropping toward normal. no 5xx spike.
mira: creating release-note PR and opening perf ticket for eng-ml. PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/1209 (draft).
nash: pause canary for ql-lite-4 until perf team signs off. scheduling postmortem invite.
mira: monitoring for 30m then will close. :white_check_mark:
